Hi Samir — thanks for the note and attachments. We're happy to get this updated. Quick checklist for us to process the change:

1) Completed vendor portal update or signed vendor change form (we accept DocuSign).
2) Clear proof of bank ownership (voided check or bank letter) — you provided both, thank you.
3) Confirmation of taxable entity name / TIN matching W-9 — W-9 received.
4) Specified effective date for switching wires (requested to avoid applying to already scheduled payments).

Couple of questions:
- Do you want the new bank to be the default for all currencies or only USD?
- Effective date? If you need it applied to the invoice due this Friday (2027-04-23), we need approval from AP by EOD tomorrow.

I've looped in Marissa from Vendor Onboarding to track the paperwork and Hannah from Procurement to approve the remit address change. Once AP signs off we'll create a finance change request (FCR-4829) and push it to our ERP.

Next steps I can own: send the vendor change form (DocuSign) today; Marissa will validate the docs; Hannah will sign off on the address change; then we route to Karthik in AP for final acceptance.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
